reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, and I have a drawer of half-used supplement bottles. I don't need it to go, and I'm not buying another one without a doctor telling me to.
objection: I don't need it. Magnesium at home at night works fine for me, and I have no reason to carry it around. Most supplements are a waste unless a doctor recommends them.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor recommending this specific product, or a blood test showing I am low in magnesium and need to take it during the day.
